name: DriveSlide: PDF Slideshow for Google Drive
description: Turn Google Drive PDFs into instant slideshows with one click. No downloading or extra tabs.

action.default_title: Present a Google Drive PDF as a slideshow

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; font-src 'self' blob: data:; worker-src 'self'; connect-src https://drive.google.com https://drive.usercontent.google.com; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; object-src 'none'
